caption: The top of a large empty cardboard box is thumped, and the lid panel bounces and quivers before settling.

sa.check: A large cardboard box with its lid panel on top.
The top of the box is thumped by a hand or fist.
The lid panel bounces and quivers.
The thump lands on the top of the box, not on a side.
The thump comes first; the bounce and quiver follow, then the settling.

pc.expect: The lid panel is still until the hand lands; it dips and rebounds at the thump and only then.
pc.fail: The panel is already quivering before the hand arrives; or quivers while the hand is held away from it; or the hand thumps and the panel stays rigid; or the panel starts quivering again after settling with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The first dip is the deepest and each later flex is smaller until the panel lies flat and still.
pc.fail: The quiver grows after the thump; or holds the same size for the whole clip; or the panel stops dead in mid-bounce.

pc.expect: The lid flexes as stiff card: it dents in under the hand and springs back; the side walls stay upright.
pc.fail: The hand's dent stays pressed in after the hand lifts; or the panel ripples like cloth; or a side wall caves in and stays; or the lid tears.

pc.expect: The box stays where it is; the sides barely move and the box does not slide or rock.
pc.fail: The box slides across the floor at the thump; or rocks up onto one edge; or the sides bulge and quiver while the lid stays still.

pc.expect: One box; the hand passes through nothing and the box stays one piece.
pc.fail: The hand passes into the lid; or the lid vanishes or a second lid appears; or the box collapses flat and re-forms; or the box changes into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The box's printing and tape, and the floor and surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The box's label or printing changes; or the tape moves or vanishes; or the floor changes.

note: 'Empty' cannot be seen through a closed lid and is not judged.
